front.name: plot-geospatial-bubble-map
front.description: Create publication-ready proportional-symbol (bubble) maps from geolocated point or gridded geoscience data. Use when circle area should encode data magnitude and optional color should encode a second variable or classes; for global, regional, or longitude/latitude maps from NetCDF, NC4, CSV, TSV, TXT, Excel, GeoTIFF/TIFF, HDF5/HDF-EOS, GRIB/GRB, or Zarr inputs; and for requests mentioning bubble maps, graduated circles, proportional symbols, geospatial scatter plots, station maps, event frequency, or value-sized circles.

json_data.name: Geospatial Bubble Map
json_data.description: 根据地学点位或网格数据的经纬度绘制比例符号气泡图，以圆面积编码数值大小，并可使用颜色编码第二变量或分类。

tasks.label: 地理比例符号气泡图绘制

usage_constraints: 源仓库未检测到许可证文件；再分发、修改或商用前应向权利人确认授权条件。
输入数据可能包含敏感地理坐标；公开地图或统计文件前应检查脱敏要求。
Cartopy自然地理底图在本地缓存缺失时可能需要网络访问。

applicability: 输入包含可解析的经度、纬度和非负大小变量。
需要在全球或区域地图上以圆面积表达数量大小。
可选地使用连续色带或离散颜色表达第二变量或类别。

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: 地理点位表格或地学网格数据。

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.description: 经度字段、坐标或可转换为空间经度的横坐标。

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.description: 纬度字段、坐标或可转换为空间纬度的纵坐标。

inputs.name: size_variable
inputs.description: 控制圆面积的非负数值变量。

inputs.name: color_variable
inputs.description: 控制连续或分级颜色的第二变量。

outputs.name: map_figure
outputs.description: PNG、PDF或SVG格式的地理气泡图。

outputs.name: statistics
outputs.description: 记录输入指纹、变量、缩减、取点、符号编码、地图参数、警告和软件版本的同名.stats.json文件。

workflow: 检查输入格式、经纬度、大小变量和可选颜色变量。
显式处理非空间维度、重复坐标、投影转换和高密度网格抽稀。
根据全球或区域范围选择投影、地图范围和视觉编码。
执行scripts/plot_bubble_map.py生成地图和统计文件。
检查圆面积含义、图例、颜色条、坐标顺序、裁切、重叠和警告。
success_conditions: 输出地图文件和同名.stats.json均成功生成。
经纬度顺序、范围和投影处理正确，并在统计文件中可追溯。
线性模式下圆面积与大小变量成比例；使用非线性变换时明确披露。
图例分级与实际符号面积、颜色分级保持一致。
所有非空间维度缩减、重复点聚合、重投影和抽稀操作均被显式记录。
出版用途输出默认达到300 DPI，除非用户另有要求。
limitations: 负值大小默认被拒绝；只有表达绝对幅度时才能显式启用绝对值。
非空间维度存在歧义时必须选择切片或缩减方法，不能静默折叠。
GeoTIFF投影坐标必须显式允许转换到EPSG:4326。
密集网格使用确定性步长取点，取点不等同于空间聚合。

coordinate_requirements.projected_input_policy: GeoTIFF pixel centers may be transformed to EPSG:4326 only when explicitly enabled.

evaluation_requirements: 检查有效坐标、有限数值及经纬度顺序。
核对符号面积与图例值的一致性。
核对连续颜色范围或离散颜色分级。
检查重叠、裁切、海岸线和国界加载警告。
核对统计文件中的点数、抽稀、聚合、缩减、投影和软件版本。

asset_protocol.failure_policy: 缺失依赖、坐标歧义、变量歧义、未授权维度缩减或未授权投影转换时停止并报告，不静默猜测。

front.name: gempy
front.description:
3D structural geological modeling using implicit methods. Create geological
models with faults, folds, and unconformities from surface points and
orientations. Use when the agent needs to: (1) Build 3D geological models from
surface contacts and orientations, (2) Model faults, unconformities, or
intrusions, (3) Compute and visualize subsurface geology, (4) Export models
to VTK or numpy arrays, (5) Generate gravity forward models, (6) Create
cross-sections or 3D visualizations.

front.name: harmonica
front.description:
Gravity and magnetic data processing and forward modelling using Fatiando a Terra.
Use when the agent needs to: (1) Compute gravity forward models (point masses, prisms,
tesseroids), (2) Apply terrain/Bouguer corrections, (3) Grid scattered potential
field data with equivalent sources, (4) Perform upward/downward continuation,
(5) Calculate magnetic anomalies from magnetized bodies, (6) Apply derivative
filters (gradients, tilt angle), (7) Process regional or local gravity surveys.

front.name: bruges
front.description:
Geophysical equations and rock physics calculations for seismic analysis.
Use when the agent needs to: (1) Calculate AVO responses (Zoeppritz, Shuey, Aki-Richards),
(2) Perform Gassmann fluid substitution, (3) Generate seismic wavelets (Ricker, Ormsby),
(4) Compute reflectivity and synthetic seismograms, (5) Calculate elastic moduli from
velocities, (6) Apply Gardner/Castagna empirical relations, (7) Model rock physics effects.

front.description:
Simulation and Parameter Estimation in Geophysics. Framework for geophysical
forward modeling and inversion. Use when the agent needs to: (1) Run geophysical
inversions (DC resistivity, magnetics, gravity, EM), (2) Create forward models
for potential fields or electromagnetic methods, (3) Build survey geometries
and receiver configurations, (4) Design mesh discretizations for simulations,
(5) Apply regularization and optimization to inverse problems, (6) Model
subsurface physical properties from geophysical data.

processing transforms (FFT, convolution, derivatives), (4) Compose operators for
complex workflows, (5) Perform regularized inversion with smoothness or sparsity
constraints, (6) Process seismic or image data at scale.

(7) Combine multiple geomorphic processes, (8) Load/save DEM data for modeling.

front.description: Expert at writing geospatial processing functions inline into the user's existing Python script or notebook. Use this skill whenever the user wants to: mask or clip raster data to an admin boundary or country, stack or combine multiple xarray Datasets into a single cube, compute zonal statistics or aggregate raster values by region or time period, or export raster data as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG).
